description: This file defines a generic implementation of an object pool policy for concurrent object pooling, implementing the IPooledObjectPolicy interface with methods to create and return objects.

classes.name: DefaultConcurrentObjectPoolPolicy<T>
classes.description: A generic pool policy that creates new objects of type T and always returns true on object return, used for managing pooled objects with concurrency support.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of type T.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Indicates whether the object can be returned to the pool; always returns true.
